answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity must trade with 20 distinct counterparties per 20-epoch horizon. A sybil ring trading only among its clones fails at once: its graph is a star. Forging 100 fakes needs 2,000 paid links; at 5 POA each, 10,000 POA burns before rewards land. Honest agents trade widely and keep full rewards; the pulse of trade is hard to fake, and a violet flag freezes rewards where partners share one funding source.
